title: Graduate Engineer (Graduate Program, civil and structural)
location: Brisbane QLD (Melbourne office at 400 Collins Street)
apply_instructions: Submit a cover letter and resume through the Graduate Program form at https://www.bornhorstward.com.au/apply (applications accepted all year).
rationale: Graduate engineer intake at a civil and structural consultancy, the entry level Marc is targeting; applications are accepted all year and the page invites graduates who did not do the firm's undergraduate placement.
Marc holds a BSCE (Philippines) and finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026 with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD.
Mentored graduate role with real project work suits his 2019 to 2020 site experience; the page mentions CAD (AutoCAD, Revit) as a plus on its general EOI.
caution: The graduate program describes Queensland projects, so the role is most likely Brisbane based and Marc would need to confirm relocation (the firm also has a Melbourne office; ask which office has graduate places). The separate general EOI page says unrestricted working rights; the graduate page does not, so Marc's 485 visa (full working rights to December 2027) should be stated clearly in the form. His degree is from the Philippines, not an Australian accredited degree.
gaps: Working rights wording on the firm's general EOI says unrestricted
employer_line: Bornhorst + Ward has been a civil and structural engineering consultancy since 1965, with offices in Brisbane and Melbourne, and runs a graduate program built on one to one mentoring and real project work from day one.
